beauville_maximal_picard.title: Some surfaces with maximal Picard number
beauville_maximal_picard.author: Arnaud Beauville
exact_supported_facts: C is the modular curve X(8).
Gamma is isomorphic to (Z/2Z)^2 and acts freely on C.
H^0(C,K_C)=L+V where Gamma acts trivially on L and V is the sum of the three nontrivial one-dimensional representations.
NS((C x C)/Gamma) tensor Q = Q^2 + (End_Gamma(JC) tensor Q).
End_Gamma(JC) tensor Q = M2(Q(sqrt(-2))) x Q(i)^3.

freitag_salvati_manni_cover.title: Parametrization of the box variety by theta functions
freitag_salvati_manni_cover.locator: Section 4, Lemma 4.1 and the definition of the Beauville manifold
exact_supported_facts: Gamma'[4]/Gamma[8] is isomorphic to (Z/2Z)^2 and acts freely on H*/Gamma[8].
The Beauville manifold is X=(H*/Gamma[8] x H*/Gamma[8])/Gamma'[4] with diagonal action.
The resolved two-fold map Xtilde -> Btilde is ramified along the 48 exceptional divisors.

rational_character_adapter.beauville_surface_model: X=(C x C)/Gamma_diag with C isomorphic to X(8) and Gamma isomorphic to V4
rational_character_adapter.deck_group: (Gamma x Gamma)/Gamma_diag isomorphic to Gamma isomorphic to V4
rational_character_adapter.deck_character_identification: On the cross-term H^1(C) tensor H^1(C), the diagonal-Gamma invariants pair equal Gamma characters; the residual deck group acts by that common character.

integral_index_boundary.reason: The cited Beauville decomposition is after tensoring NS with Q. A rational Q(i) character algebra does not determine the integral lattice index, integral order, primitive embedding, or intersection-form scale needed for a congruence or norm restriction on E_t^2.
